name: entity.before.create
when: an entity is about to be created (any entity type the subscription lists)
subject: the entity record: `{ id, type, ...fields, ext: { <plugin>: {...} } }` as submitted
comment: validate or normalize the new record, or veto with a message
example: **comments** rejects a comment over the length limit or from a blocked user; **spam** vetoes obvious spam

name: entity.after.create
when: the entity was created and stored
subject: the entity record: `{ id, type, ...fields, ext: { <plugin>: {...} } }` as stored, with its new `id`
returns: the record as the caller receives it (annotations); the store is not rewritten
comment: react to the new record: notify, index, update a derived store
example: **search** indexes the new record; **notifications** emails moderators about a new comment

name: entity.before.read
when: an entity or list is about to be read
subject: `{ type, id?, query }` (what is being asked for)
returns: the request (narrow a query, add filters)
comment: narrow what is read (for example hide drafts from anonymous callers), or veto
example: **comments** hides unapproved comments from anonymous readers by narrowing the query

name: entity.after.read
when: the entity or list was loaded
subject: the record, or `{ items: [records], total }` for a list, with `ext.<plugin>` annotations
returns: the record or list as the caller receives it (annotate, redact)
comment: annotate or redact what the caller receives; not detachable because the caller waits for it
example: **example** adds an `ext.awesome.explosions` count to each file it lists; **privacy** redacts emails for non-admins

name: entity.before.update
when: an entity is about to be updated
subject: the entity record: `{ id, type, ...fields, ext: { <plugin>: {...} } }` with the submitted changes merged
comment: compare with ctx.previous, normalize, or veto
example: **announcements** refuses to edit an announcement that is already published to all users

name: entity.after.update
when: the update was stored
subject: the entity record: `{ id, type, ...fields, ext: { <plugin>: {...} } }` as stored
returns: the record as the caller receives it
comment: react to what changed between ctx.previous and the subject
example: **search** re-indexes; **page-cache** invalidates cached pages that showed the record

name: entity.before.delete
when: an entity is about to be deleted
subject: the stored record
comment: refuse deletion (for example while something depends on it), or veto
example: **media-library** refuses to delete a file that pages still embed

name: entity.after.delete
when: the entity was deleted
subject: the record as it was before deletion
comment: clean up anything that pointed at the deleted record
example: **comments** deletes the thread when its page is deleted (cascade)

name: page.before.save
when: page content or metadata is about to be written (editor save, CLI, import)
subject: the page: `{ id, siteId, title, location, slug, parent, order, content, metadata }` as submitted
returns: the page (may change content or metadata)
comment: inspect or adjust the page before it is written (for example clean up markup), or veto
example: **a11y-check** warns about images without alt text; **content-sanitize** strips pasted Word markup
alias: entity.before.create and entity.before.update for entity type page, with the page content loaded

name: page.after.save
when: the page was written to disk
subject: the page: `{ id, siteId, title, location, slug, parent, order, content, metadata }` as written
comment: react to the saved page: re-index for search, invalidate a cache, notify
example: **search** re-indexes the page; **page-cache** drops that page's cached HTML; **xapi** records an authoring event
alias: entity.after.create and entity.after.update for entity type page

name: manifest.before.save
when: site.json is about to be written (outline change, settings save, theme change)
subject: the site manifest: the full `site.json` object (`{ id, title, author, metadata, items: [...] }`) as it will be written
comment: inspect or adjust site.json before it is written, or veto
example: **regions** moves region data out of `site.json` into its own store before the write
alias: entity.before.update for entity type site (its site.json record)

name: manifest.after.save
when: site.json was written
subject: the site manifest: the full `site.json` object (`{ id, title, author, metadata, items: [...] }`) as written
comment: react to outline or settings changes: rebuild a derived file, notify
example: **sitemap / llms.txt** regenerate; **page-cache** clears the menu-dependent cache

name: config.before.read
when: a plugin's configuration is about to be read (subscription `config` list decides whose)
subject: `{ plugin, scope, siteId?, keys? }`
comment: uncommon: audit or restrict access to configuration
example: **config-audit** records which plugin or user read secrets-adjacent config (uncommon)

name: config.after.read
when: the configuration was loaded
subject: `{ plugin, scope, siteId?, values }` (the plugin whose config it is, system or site scope, the settings values); secret values are already redacted
returns: the values as the caller receives them
comment: uncommon: redact or annotate values for the caller
example: **multi-tenant** (HAXiam) overlays institution defaults onto a site's values (uncommon)

name: config.before.save
when: configuration is about to be written (dashboard, `hax plugin config set`, install migration)
subject: `{ plugin, scope, siteId?, values }` (the plugin whose config it is, system or site scope, the settings values) as submitted
comment: validate or normalize a settings change, or veto
example: **google-analytics** rejects a malformed measurement ID

name: config.after.save
when: configuration was written; requirements are re-evaluated after this
subject: `{ plugin, scope, siteId?, values }` (the plugin whose config it is, system or site scope, the settings values) as written
comment: react to a settings change: clear a cache, copy to a backup location
example: **config-backup** copies every change to a backup location; **page-cache** clears after a theme setting change

name: git.before.commit
when: HAXcms is about to make a git commit for a site (after a page or manifest save)
subject: `{ siteId, message, files: [paths], author }`
returns: the commit (adjust the message or add files)
comment: last chance to add files or adjust the commit message, or veto the commit
example: **changelog** adds a CHANGELOG entry to the commit and rewrites the message

name: git.after.commit
when: the commit was made
subject: `{ siteId, hash, message, files: [paths], author }`
comment: push or rsync the site elsewhere; usually `detached: true`
example: **rsync-deploy** pushes the site to a remote server (`detached: true`)

name: rest.before.request
when: a request to a plugin or core route is about to reach its handler
subject: the request: `{ method, path, operationId, headers, query, body, user? }`
returns: the request (may change headers, query or body)
comment: check or adjust the request before the handler runs, or refuse it
example: **rate-limit-plus** applies a stricter limit per token; **mcp** checks the scoped token's site and read-only flag

name: rest.after.request
when: the handler produced a response, before it is sent
subject: the response: `{ status, headers, body }`, with the request in ctx.request
comment: adjust the response before it is sent; not detachable
example: **cors** adds headers for an allowed origin; **privacy** trims fields for anonymous callers

name: plugin.before.requirements
when: status is being calculated (enable, settings save, dashboard load)
subject: the list of unmet requirements so far: `[{ key, message }]`
returns: the list with this plugin's own unmet requirements added
comment: report unmet requirements; the plugin stays enabled but inactive until the list is empty
example: **google-analytics** stays inactive until a measurement ID is set; a plugin that needs **cookie-consent** waits for it

name: plugin.after.requirements
when: the requirements list is final and status is set
subject: `{ id, scope, siteId?, status, unmet: [{ key, message }] }`
comment: react to becoming active or inactive
example: **onboarding** shows the admin a setup checklist when a plugin turns inactive

name: plugin.before.install
when: about to install (runs once, the first time the plugin is enabled in a scope)
subject: `{ id, version, scope, siteId? }` (the plugin changing state)
comment: check preconditions for install; veto to refuse
example: **announcements** checks the system can write its system store before installing

name: plugin.after.install
when: install finished
subject: `{ id, version, scope, siteId? }` (the plugin changing state)
comment: migrate settings that used to live in site.json or core config into this plugin's settings
example: **google-analytics** moves `gaID` out of `site.json` into its own settings (first enable)

name: plugin.before.enable
when: about to enable (runs every time the plugin is enabled in a scope)
subject: `{ id, version, scope, siteId? }` (the plugin changing state)
comment: check preconditions for enable; veto to refuse
example: **mcp** refuses to enable on a site whose deployment blocks it

name: plugin.after.enable
when: enable finished
subject: `{ id, version, scope, siteId? }` (the plugin changing state)
comment: set up what the plugin needs at runtime
example: **log** starts collecting; any plugin observes another being enabled (for example **views** registering a source)

name: plugin.before.disable
when: about to disable (runs when the plugin is disabled in a scope; data is kept)
subject: `{ id, version, scope, siteId? }` (the plugin changing state)
comment: check preconditions for disable; veto to refuse
example: **theme pack** refuses while a site still uses its theme (core also enforces this)

name: plugin.after.disable
when: disable finished
subject: `{ id, version, scope, siteId? }` (the plugin changing state)
comment: tear down what enable set up; core clears caches and rebuilds managed outputs
example: **page-cache** removes its cache folder; **ssr** removes its compiled renderers

name: plugin.before.uninstall
when: about to uninstall (runs when the plugin is uninstalled after disable; its data is purged)
subject: `{ id, version, scope, siteId? }` (the plugin changing state)
comment: check preconditions for uninstall; veto to refuse
example: **comments** warns that all threads will be purged and requires confirmation

name: plugin.after.uninstall
when: uninstall finished
subject: `{ id, version, scope, siteId? }` (the plugin changing state)
comment: remove anything outside the plugin's own stores
example: **media-library** removes thumbnails it wrote outside its own stores

name: plugin.before.upgrade
when: about to upgrade (runs when a newer version is installed, around its upgrade steps)
subject: `{ id, version, scope, siteId? }` (the plugin changing state)
comment: check preconditions for upgrade; veto to refuse
example: **views** snapshots view definitions before an upgrade step changes their shape

name: plugin.after.upgrade
when: upgrade finished
subject: `{ id, version, scope, siteId? }` (the plugin changing state)
comment: prepare for or follow up on data upgrades
example: **announcements** marks new tips as unread after an upgrade

name: site.before.create
when: a site is about to be created
subject: the site summary: `{ id, name, title, path, theme, owner }`; a skeleton or import can be adjusted in the before hook
comment: check or adjust before the site is created, or veto
example: **institution-skeleton** (HAXiam) forces the institution theme and license onto new sites

name: site.after.create
when: the site was created
subject: the site summary: `{ id, name, title, path, theme, owner }` as it is after the operation
comment: react after the site is created
example: **announcements** queues the welcome tip for the new site owner

name: site.before.duplicate
when: a site is about to be duplicated
subject: the site summary: `{ id, name, title, path, theme, owner }`; subject is the source site; ctx.target is the new one
comment: check or adjust before the site is duplicated, or veto
example: **retention** blocks duplicating a site under legal hold

name: site.after.duplicate
when: the site was duplicated
subject: the site summary: `{ id, name, title, path, theme, owner }` as it is after the operation
comment: react after the site is duplicated
example: **comments** starts the copy with no comments (siteData is not copied)

name: site.before.archive
when: a site is about to be archived
subject: the site summary: `{ id, name, title, path, theme, owner }`
comment: check or adjust before the site is archived, or veto
example: **lms-sync** refuses to archive a site still linked to an active course

name: site.after.archive
when: the site was archived
subject: the site summary: `{ id, name, title, path, theme, owner }` as it is after the operation
comment: react after the site is archived
example: **search** removes the site from the system index

name: site.before.delete
when: a site is about to be deleted
subject: the site summary: `{ id, name, title, path, theme, owner }`
comment: check or adjust before the site is deleted, or veto
example: **retention** blocks deletion while a retention policy is active

name: site.after.delete
when: the site was deleted
subject: the site summary: `{ id, name, title, path, theme, owner }` as it is after the operation
comment: react after the site is deleted
example: **analytics** removes stored reports for the site

name: site.before.export
when: a site is about to be exported
subject: the site summary: `{ id, name, title, path, theme, owner }`; ctx.format names the export format
comment: check or adjust before the site is exported, or veto
example: **restricted-assets** removes files whose redistribution is restricted from the export

name: site.after.export
when: the site was exported
subject: the site summary: `{ id, name, title, path, theme, owner }` as it is after the operation
comment: react after the site is exported
example: **epub / pdf / docx exporters** attach their output alongside the zip

name: user.before.login
when: a user is about to login
subject: the user: a limited record `{ id, name, displayName, roles, avatar }` by default; the full record (email and profile fields, never the password or tokens) only with the `users:full` capability
comment: refuse the login (for example outside allowed hours), or veto
example: **sso** (HAXiam) refuses local logins when SSO is required

name: user.after.login
when: the user login finished
subject: the user: a limited record `{ id, name, displayName, roles, avatar }` by default; the full record (email and profile fields, never the password or tokens) only with the `users:full` capability
comment: react to the login: record it, warm a cache
example: **announcements** shows unread What's New items; **log** records the login

name: user.before.logout
when: a user is about to logout
subject: the user: a limited record `{ id, name, displayName, roles, avatar }` by default; the full record (email and profile fields, never the password or tokens) only with the `users:full` capability
comment: refuse the logout (for example outside allowed hours), or veto
example: **autosave** flushes an unsaved draft first

name: user.after.logout
when: the user logout finished
subject: the user: a limited record `{ id, name, displayName, roles, avatar }` by default; the full record (email and profile fields, never the password or tokens) only with the `users:full` capability
comment: react to the logout: record it, warm a cache
example: **session-cleanup** clears that user's cached tokens

name: register.before.routes
when: the platform is collecting OpenAPI paths contributed by plugins
subject: the list collected so far
returns: the list with this plugin's additions
comment: add to the routes list
example: **views** adds a route per saved view; **mcp** adds its discovery operation

name: register.after.routes
when: the routes list is complete
subject: the merged list from every plugin
comment: inspect the final routes list (audit, conflicts)
example: **api-docs** builds a combined OpenAPI document for the dashboard

name: register.before.entities
when: the platform is collecting entity definitions
subject: the list collected so far
returns: the list with this plugin's additions
comment: add to the entities list
example: **example** adds `awesomeFile` extending `file`

name: register.after.entities
when: the entities list is complete
subject: the merged list from every plugin
comment: inspect the final entities list (audit, conflicts)
example: **schema-report** warns about two plugins annotating the same field

name: register.before.contracts
when: the platform is collecting contract implementations
subject: the list collected so far
returns: the list with this plugin's additions
comment: add to the contracts list
example: **importer-moodle** implements `import.platform`

name: register.after.contracts
when: the contracts list is complete
subject: the merged list from every plugin
comment: inspect the final contracts list (audit, conflicts)
example: **importers** lists every available import platform in the UI

name: register.before.prompts
when: the platform is collecting prompts (seeded from docs/prompts.yaml) for the plugin screen and the MCP plugin
subject: the list collected so far
returns: the list with this plugin's additions
comment: add to the prompts list
example: **any plugin** adds a 'fix this' prompt only when it currently has unmet requirements

name: register.after.prompts
when: the prompts list is complete
subject: the merged list from every plugin
comment: inspect the final prompts list (audit, conflicts)
example: **mcp** serves the final list through MCP's prompts feature

name: render.before
when: a page is about to be rendered (live request or static publish)
subject: the render context: `{ site, page, theme, head: [tags], content, body: { start: [], end: [] }, html }`, filled in as the stages progress; only site, page and theme are set
returns: the context, or `ctx.respond(html)` to short-circuit with a cached document
comment: serve a cached document with ctx.respond(html), or prepare the context
example: **page-cache** returns the cached HTML with `ctx.respond(html)` and skips the rest

name: render.before.head
when: the head is about to be assembled
subject: the render context: `{ site, page, theme, head: [tags], content, body: { start: [], end: [] }, html }`, filled in as the stages progress
comment: add meta, link and script tags to the head
example: **google-analytics** adds the consent-gated loader; **seo-plus** adds extra meta tags

name: render.after.head
when: the head is assembled
subject: the render context: `{ site, page, theme, head: [tags], content, body: { start: [], end: [] }, html }`, filled in as the stages progress; head is final
comment: inspect or reorder the final head
example: **csp** computes a Content-Security-Policy from the final head

name: render.before.content
when: the page content is about to be placed in the shell
subject: the render context: `{ site, page, theme, head: [tags], content, body: { start: [], end: [] }, html }`, filled in as the stages progress; content is the stored page HTML
comment: transform content before it is placed, for example server-side render custom elements
example: **ssr** renders custom elements to HTML; **glossary** links defined terms

name: render.after.content
when: the content is placed
subject: the render context: `{ site, page, theme, head: [tags], content, body: { start: [], end: [] }, html }`, filled in as the stages progress; content is final
comment: inspect or post-process the placed content
example: **a11y-check** flags the rendered page in preview mode

name: render.before.body
when: right after the opening body tag
subject: the render context: `{ site, page, theme, head: [tags], content, body: { start: [], end: [] }, html }`, filled in as the stages progress
comment: inject markup at the start of the body
example: **skip-links** or a **maintenance-banner** right after `<body>`

name: render.after.body
when: right before the closing body tag
subject: the render context: `{ site, page, theme, head: [tags], content, body: { start: [], end: [] }, html }`, filled in as the stages progress
comment: inject singletons and scripts at the end of the body, with settings baked in from the plugin's config
example: **cookie-consent** banner, **announcements** toast, **example** `awesome-counter` singleton with settings baked in

name: render.after
when: the document is complete
subject: the render context: `{ site, page, theme, head: [tags], content, body: { start: [], end: [] }, html }`, filled in as the stages progress; html is the final document
comment: last chance to alter the final document; store it in a cache
example: **page-cache** stores the final document; **minify** compresses it

name: rebuild.before
when: managed files are about to be regenerated (registries, page shells, static output)
subject: `{ scope, siteId?, reason }`
comment: prepare for a rebuild, or veto it
example: **static-publish** clears its output folder

name: rebuild.after
when: managed files were regenerated
subject: `{ scope, siteId?, reason, files: [paths] }`
comment: write this plugin's own managed files
example: **sitemap / llms.txt**, **views** snapshots and feeds, **search** index file

name: schedule.before.run
when: a scheduled job is about to run (from `hax plugin schedule run` or the timer plugin)
subject: `{ job, plugin, scope, siteId?, lastRun }`
comment: skip a job run (for example during maintenance)
example: **maintenance-mode** skips jobs during a maintenance window

name: schedule.after.run
when: the scheduled job finished
subject: `{ job, plugin, scope, siteId?, ok, durationMs, error? }`
comment: record the result or alert on failure
example: **log** records the result; **notifications** alerts on a failed job
